name: tablecheck-crawler
description: Watch TableCheck restaurants for openings and prefill the reservation form

scripts.ui: npm run build && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && electron . --lang=en
scripts.ui:ja: npm run build && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && electron . --lang=ja
scripts.ui:dev: npm run build && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && electron . --enable-logging
